purpose: Test whether a density-supported novel stratum is robust to the arbitrary choice of similarity view before it becomes permanent taxonomy structure.
mechanism_placeholder: consensus/stability across materially different predeclared similarity views
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local anomaly cluster trace only; metric consensus is a robustness guard, not proof that either metric reflects semantic truth.

views.V1_HAMMING: same scope_family and unweighted Hamming distance <=1 over four boolean sensitivity fields
views.V2_JACCARD: same scope_family and Jaccard similarity >=0.67 over the set of active sensitivity flags

consensus_rule: A novel-stratum candidate may proceed only if the same three unique terminal anomaly identities U1,U2,U3 form the supported core under both V1_HAMMING and V2_JACCARD. A copied/equivalent view cannot count as a second view. If core membership differs, keep the candidate unresolved and do not select the more favorable metric after observing outcomes.

fixed_trace.expected: ineligible as non-diverse metric views even if both produce the same cluster
consensus core; candidate may proceed only after both view artifacts are durably read back

fixed_trace.control: V1 core U1,U2,U3 but V2 core only U1,U2
fixed_trace.expected: metric disagreement; no taxonomy activation and no credit

fixed_trace.event: after disagreement, widen V2 threshold until U3 joins
duplicate/stale/transport-only anomaly appears in both views
late completion from old metric/taxonomy generation

fixed_trace.control: no two materially different views agree on a supported core
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: both similarity views and thresholds are frozen before public source audit
guards.G2: copied/equivalent metric views cannot count as independent robustness evidence
guards.G3: candidate core membership must agree exactly across V1 and V2
guards.G5: post-outcome threshold tuning is forbidden in this generation
guards.G6: only unique terminal same-scope anomaly identities can enter a supported core
guards.G8: consensus artifacts must be sealed/read back before later taxonomy activation
guards.G9: late old metric/taxonomy-generation completions are stale
guards.G10: absence of consensus remains unresolved with nonempty frontier rather than selecting the favorable metric
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source metric/threshold/rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one role-local credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that agreement of two hand-chosen metrics can still share a common bias.
